historical_reviews.deepseek: Passive readback is useful, but it does not enumerate PSU1 and PSU2, exposes the password, truncates SDR and omits Web evidence.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly protects power state and requires rail context. This review distinguishes motherboard-side feed power from PSU-internal or PDB telemetry.
historical_reviews.duplicate_search: No duplicate code; adjacent PDB PSU channels cannot substitute for motherboard measurement points.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-35 requires both range members, ED-36 requires topology and semantics, and ED-38 reserves power state and verdict actions.

original_test_intent: Validate the two PWR_MB_PSU channels as motherboard-side PSU1 and PSU2 feed-power readings, with fitted supply identity, electrical measurement point, readable value and enabled thresholds in raw and both Web views.
original_method: The power owner maps PSU1/PSU2 slots and serials to motherboard connectors/rails and sensors, defines whether the reading is input to the motherboard or another aggregate, supplies redundancy/load-state limits, and automation collects passive evidence.
manual_activity: The power/platform owner binds PSU1 and PSU2 serials, AC feeds and motherboard connectors to the two sensors, approves measurement semantics and load-sharing limits, and confirms both Web views. No PSU service or power change is authorized.
required_inputs: PSU1/PSU2 bay, serial, AC feed and motherboard connector/rail map
Sensor controller/channel and exact motherboard-side measurement point
Whether values are per-feed input, downstream rail power or derived aggregate
Units, scaling, accuracy, sampling/averaging and freshness
Approved ranges and enabled thresholds for documented load and redundancy state
Exact SDR/entity and both Web mappings plus firmware/spec revisions
Secret-safe passive collector, full retention and independent power/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Query PSU1 and PSU2 separately; the tilde label is not one sensor
Bind each value to a fitted PSU serial, AC feed and motherboard connector
Do not equate motherboard-side power with PSU PMBus output or PDB measurement without approved correlation
Retain complete SDR and threshold flags; no truncated fallback
Do not remove supplies, change feeds/load, issue PMBus/power/threshold writes, reset BMC or clear logs
Stop on stale/missing power, unsafe imbalance, redundancy loss, rail/thermal fault or BMC instability; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete read-only SDR and both exact MB-PSU records
Parse values, state, sampling, freshness and thresholds
Prepare Web parity and passive redundancy/load-share context
Perform no PSU/power/PMBus control or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve PSU-slot-feed-connector mapping and measurement boundary
Provide redundancy-state ranges, thresholds and imbalance rules
Confirm Web mappings and missing/degraded behavior
Review both channels with PSU/rail context and issue the verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Read-only direction fits only after two exact names are mapped; the literal range, truncation, password argument and missing PSU/feed/Web provenance prevent execution readiness.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secret-safe OOB access to retain full SDR and query each mapped MB-PSU record, then reconcile the same fitted supply/feed in both Web views without changing power state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PSU1~2 scope, two Web paths, criterion and time estimates remain; topology and thresholds are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES MOTHERBOARD PSU-FEED POWER MAPPING AND THRESHOLD PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a two-row PSU-serial/AC-feed/motherboard-connector sensor matrix and reconcile passive raw/Web values with load-sharing rules.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the motherboard electrical boundary and redundancy context while expanding the shorthand.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: PSU-internal or PDB telemetry cannot replace these two motherboard-side channels unless an owner-approved equivalence exists.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A swapped feed map or unrecognized derived aggregate can make balanced-looking readings conceal a failed path.

project_override_considerations: Single-PSU configurations require explicit N/A/degraded rules. If one sensor represents total motherboard input rather than a per-supply path, the source label conflict must be escalated before execution rather than splitting the aggregate by assumption.
expected_evidence: PSU1/PSU2 serial, AC-feed, connector and rail topology
Measurement semantics, SDR/entity and both Web mappings
Values, units, sampling/freshness, enabled thresholds and load-share limits
Complete redacted SDR and both exact outputs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row consistently targets two motherboard PSU power channels. Missing electrical mapping and numeric criteria are readiness inputs; no contradictory method is present.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A passive two-channel readback path is identifiable, and feed mapping plus limits are supplyable under ED-36.

review_improvement: Establishes the motherboard-side electrical boundary, fitted-PSU provenance and redundancy/load-sharing interpretation, keeping PDB and PSU-internal telemetry separate.
independent_technical_reasoning: Two sensors named by PSU can be located upstream, downstream or inside the supplies. Conversion loss and shared rails make those readings non-equivalent. A correct verdict requires serial/feed/connector provenance and a documented redundancy state, especially because normal load sharing need not be exactly 50/50.
